spectral.label: Spectral (apparitions, phantoms, poltergeists)
spectral.lore_focus: folklore and paranormal-investigation countermeasures against ghosts and apparitions

corporeal.label: Corporeal (zombies, werewolves, vampires, cryptids)
corporeal.lore_focus: folklore weaknesses of physical monsters and crowd-safety barricading

anomalous.label: Anomalous (cursed tech, rifts, unknown signals)
anomalous.lore_focus: electromagnetic interference shielding and folklore of cursed machines

components.ThreatBanner: One-line situation headline and the directive for the floor. Use when the incident needs an immediate order.
components.EMFGauge: Live electromagnetic field gauge in milligauss, with a danger threshold and trend. Only when the incident reports EMF.
components.ThermalReadout: Temperature anomaly against the room baseline. Only when the incident reports a temperature.
components.FloorPlan: Loft floor plan: the hot sector, sectors to seal, and a safe route out.
components.CivilianTracker: People at risk: how many, where, their condition and extraction priority. Only when people are involved.
components.CountermeasurePicker: Ranked countermeasures from the playbook arsenal, each tied to a grounding source. The operator picks one to dispatch.
components.SystemsBoard: Status of facility systems the incident mentions (network, security, power, doors).
components.SourceLedger: The You.com sources the station is grounded in, with the ones the plan leans on marked.
components.SkyClock: Countdown to sunset, civil dusk, full dark and moonrise, with the moon's phase. Only for scenario steps, when the time of day changes the threat.

squelch.label: Radio squelch
squelch.prompt: Short burst of walkie-talkie radio squelch, a crisp static click

alert_chime.label: Alert chime: a real incident, the station is ready

all_clear.label: All clear: a harmless report, nothing to contain
all_clear.prompt: Soft, gentle descending two-note chime signaling all clear, calm and reassuring

ambient_drone.label: Ambient drone loop
ambient_drone.prompt: Low, dark ambient drone with a faint electrical hum, eerie haunted control room atmosphere
